one_liner_en: An interactive guessing-game book — Coco finds mysterious eggs and the reader guesses which animal each belongs to
one_liner_fr: Un livre interactif de devinettes — Coco trouve des œufs mystérieux et le lecteur devine à quel animal chacun appartient
key_moments: Coco finds a tiny speckled egg in the grass — whose is it?
A giant blue egg in a tree — could it be a peacock?
A strange leathery egg by the river — a turtle perhaps?
Each reveal: the baby animal hatching
Final twist: Coco himself was once an egg
